warnings: SCOPE: This expected-tree covers the JS pnpm sub-tree only (pnpm-lock.yaml scope). Python sub-project packages/ml must be detected by the Python resolver via pylock.toml (PEP 751). Cargo sub-project packages/cli must be detected by the Cargo resolver via Cargo.lock. Neither Python nor Cargo packages should appear in this tree.

NEW_FORMAT: pnpm-workspace.yaml contains a new 'ecosystems:' block (pnpm 12.4+). If the pnpm YAML parser throws on this block, the scan will produce zero JS deps. The ecosystems block must be parsed without error and then ignored by the pnpm resolver.

NEW_LOCKFILE: packages/ml/pylock.toml uses PEP 751 format. Mend's Python resolver must recognize this lockfile type alongside poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, etc. If unrecognized, the Python sub-tree is silently missed.
COORDINATE_PREFIX: pnpm 12.4 uses 'pypi:' and 'crate:' prefixes for cross-ecosystem coordinate declarations. These prefixes must NOT be interpreted as npm package names by the pnpm resolver.

RESOLVER_GAP: The upstream pnpm resolver doc (SHA 351915ae, fetched 2026-09-08) covers lockfileVersion up to 9.0 and does not mention pnpm 12.4 multi-ecosystem workspaces. This probe is exploratory — no regression baseline exists yet.
SIBLING_PROBE: See version-pm-multi-ecosystem-pre-vs-post-12-4 in version-variations.md for the paired probe (pnpm 11.x JS-only vs pnpm 12.4 multi-ecosystem).
